about.p1: With accumulated experience in fields as diverse as finance, IT, commercial, and real estate, my unique objective is to care for your business as if it were my own. To achieve this, I have surrounded myself with a capable professional structure to provide you with excellent service.
about.p2: Today, and despite ongoing continuous training and learning, I feel perfectly qualified to serve you in the most appropriate and advantageous way for your business, whether it is SELLING, BUYING, or RENTING a property.

investment.title1:
Bare Ownership + Lifetime Usufruct
An investment tailored to you
investment.businessP1: This type of investment stems from the capability to lock up capital that will only become available in the medium to long term, depending on the age of the usufructuary.
investment.businessP2: In the specific case of this deal, the proposal comes with minor procedural changes requested by the current owner and future usufructuary, such as leaving the following costs on their side:
investment.noRent: Absence of any rent to be paid.
investment.lifetimeUsufruct: Lifetime usufruct, meaning ownership of the property will only pass to the future owner upon the passing of the usufructuary.
